rubrics.rubric: Does the reconciliation summary, whether placed at the end of the Donors sheet or on a clearly labeled dedicated sheet, include the three required metrics: total new donors added, existing donors updated, and data conflicts requiring management review?
criterion: A clearly labeled reconciliation summary exists either at the end of the Donors sheet or on a dedicated worksheet.
The summary includes the metric for total new donors added.
The summary includes the metric for existing donors updated.
The summary includes the metric for data conflicts requiring management review.
The summary correctly reflects that the original database's 'Sample Donor' and 'Sample Donor 2' do not match any Q4 donors.

rubrics.rubric: Does the reconciled donor database include complete data fields for all 20 Q4 donations including Date, Donor Type, Email, Phone, Address, Amount, Payment Method, and Campaign?
criterion: All 20 Q4 donations are present in the donor database.
Each donation record includes date, donor type (Individual/Organization), email, and phone fields.
Each donation record includes address fields (street, city, state, zip).
Each donation record includes amount, payment method (Credit Card/Check/Bank Transfer), and campaign assignment.
